## Scope

The audit covered 396 second reads taken during the quarter. The review examined the consistency of grading across the audit sample and provided an overall measure of agreement. This scope reflects the second reads included in the audit and does not extend beyond that material.

## Result

Overall agreement was 68.9 per cent. The result provides the summary measure for the audit and should be considered alongside the detailed findings. Per-grader results are recorded in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately to support review of individual performance and any appropriate follow-up. The spreadsheet remains the source for the per-grader detail, while this document records the overall audit result.
